text:
Maria S.: FYI the external pen-test report just landed in the readroom. I skimmed — 12 findings, mostly medium, a couple high (S3 exposures + missing KMS key policies). We need a plan: triage owners, RBAC temp roles for assessors, audit export, and retest window. @Devon K. @Alex P. can you help slot resources?
Jordan H.: Uploaded a short vuln-summary to the thread and linked the report: https://vault/readroom/pt-2026-03-22.pdf. TL;DR: 2 auth bypass-ish, 3 S3 ACL issues, 1 KMS policy omission. I annotated suggested severity and quick mitigations.
Devon K.: Ack. My ask: pick two candidate retest windows (4h each) next week. Need oncall overlap for infra + eng-sre. Also want ephemeral creds and read-only audit exports prepared beforehand.
Alex P.: For RBAC I propose creating an ephemeral role 'pt_assessor_v1' with a time-limited session policy: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket (scoped to readroom bucket), kms:Decrypt? maybe kms:ListKeys + cloudtrail:LookupEvents. We should avoid kms:GenerateDataKey. Thoughts?
Priya R.: Agree on limiting KMS. Assessors only need to verify ciphertext presence and key metadata; no decryption needed. So kms:ListKeys and kms:DescribeKey should be fine. Also we must ensure CloudTrail logs for kms:CreateGrant/Retire are in the export.
Sam (sec-bot): Evidence upload event: report_pt_20260322.pdf uploaded by jordan.h at 1727384910. Link: https://vault/readroom/pt-2026-03-22.pdf :white_check_mark:
Maria S.: @Priya good call. That avoids over-privileging. @Alex please add the exact IAM policy snippet you want and I'll run it through IAM review. Also ask oncall to stand by during slot creation.
Alex P.: Policy sketch: ```{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket","kms:ListKeys","kms:DescribeKey","cloudtrail:LookupEvents"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::readroom-bucket/*","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"] }]}``` Will tighten resources to the report key and bucket. TTL via STS assume-role external-id and session-duration 1h.
Devon K.: Good. Ops checklist for retest: 1) snapshot logs export (last 30d) 2) enable high-fidelity CloudTrail for the window 3) provision ephemeral role with OCID and expiry 4) oncall pager assigned 5) test assessor login flow. I can run steps 1-3 by EOD if we confirm windows.
Jordan H.: Candidate windows: Tue 2026-03-30 09:00-13:00 PT or Thu 2026-04-01 16:00-20:00 PT. Prefer Tue morning for more cross-team overlap.
Priya R.: Tue works for compliance reviewer. I'll pre-check audit export retention mapping and stash a checklist.
Maria S.: Let's take Tue. Devon please create the ephemeral role and post the exact assume-role command for assessors. Alex, tighten the policy resource ARNs and paste here. I'll ping sales/legal if we need the external assessor NDA sign-off.
Alex P.: Updated policy with ARNs and session policy. Assume-role command (example): `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt_assessor_v1 --role-session-name pt-assess-session --duration-seconds 3600 --external-id PT2026`
Sam (sec-bot): Reminder: When role is created, generate audit ticket (TRIAGE-PT-20260322) for evidence chain.
Devon K.: Done. I'll provision role tomorrow morning and post the creds flow in #eng-oncall (sensitive details via readroom). Also scheduling oncall overlap with @Jordan H.
Maria S.: Thanks all. Action items: Jordan finalize vuln list in the doc, Devon create role + run export, Alex lock down policy ARNs, Priya verify audit retention, Maria coordinate NDA. We'll do a quick pre-run 30m check on Mon 2026-03-29 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Priya R.: Added pre-run checklist to the report and flagged retention questions for legal.
Jordan H.: I'll update the readroom and set TRIAGE-PT-20260322 assignees.
Maria S.: Closing thread for now — will reopen if anything blocks.
